== Course of events ==

Alice enters the Duchess's kitchen and encounters a scene of striking disorder. The air is thick with smoke—so much that it obscures the space itself—while an abundance of pepper has scattered chaos throughout the room. The Duchess herself is present within this bewildering domain. Having just encountered the Queen's footmen, who bore an invitation for the Duchess to attend a croquet game, Alice now finds herself in another of Wonderland's most extreme spaces: a kitchen where all conventional order has given way to sensory confusion. Smoke and pepper reign absolute, creating an atmosphere where the dream-logic of Wonderland reaches new heights of nonsensical excess.
